answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity costly through proof of attestation, not hoarded capital. Reputation becomes a living nebula of verified work rather than a static relic anyone can clone. Each agent must continuously attest to real transactions, causing fake identities to spiral into unsustainable costs. When creating an army of sock puppets requires genuine creative labor across epochs, the attack collapses under its own weight. Trust emerges from verifiable action, not birth certificates.
